The cleanup-section header says "runs it at the end of step 1 instead" (emphasis added), where "instead" means "not in step 0". The word "too" vs "instead" is slightly inconsistent. The runtime path is unambiguous because Step 1 has the explicit operational trigger, but the Step 0 bullet's wording could mislead readers into thinking the cleanup runs in both step 0 and step 1. This is a minor wording inconsistency.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  Line or code reference: line 12 (new Step 0 bullet "run the [Zombie-checker cleanup](#zombie-checker-cleanup) too") and line 187 (cleanup-section header "An issue-mode resume without a `— resume.` block runs it at the end of step 1 instead, because it needs the plan header's `Source issue:` line:")
  Problem: The Step 0 bullet uses the word "too", which implies an additive Step 0 cleanup in addition to the Step 1 trigger. The cleanup-section header explicitly uses "instead", stating the issue-mode path replaces the Step 0 cleanup with a Step 1 invocation. The two wordings disagree on whether Step 0 still runs the cleanup in the issue-mode-without-`— resume.`-block case.
  Why it fails at runtime: A session interpreting "too" literally would attempt the cleanup at the end of Step 0 (no Source issue available yet, predicate falls through silently) and again at the end of Step 1. A session interpreting "instead" would skip the Step 0 cleanup entirely. Both reach the same end state because the cleanup is idempotent (only archives not-archived-yet sessions and skips self + working ones), so the runtime outcome is correct, but the Step 0 bullet's wording invites divergent interpretations across sessions and future edits. The contract test (`test_issue_mode_archives_stopped_stage_sessions`) checks that the Step 1 trigger is inside Step 1 and that the cleanup-section header carries the "step 1 instead" wording, but it does not pin the Step 0 bullet's wording.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  Line or code reference: line 190 (cleanup sub-bullet "Issue mode: stopped stage sessions.") and line 192 (report line "Report the count (`Zombie checkers archived: <n>`, plus `stopped stage sessions archived: <m>` in issue mode).")
  Problem: The cleanup logs a `stopped stage sessions kept: label read failed` message only when the label read fails. Two other outcomes produce no explanation: (a) the plan header lacks a `Source issue:` line, in which case the Step 0 bullet says "a plan without that line skips this" and the cleanup does not run at all, but the report line never fires and no log distinguishes "cleanup skipped because not issue mode" from "cleanup ran and matched nothing"; (b) the source issue still carries `ai:claude-blocked`, in which case the bullet says "A session whose issue still carries the label stays" and the report line still produces `<m>=0`, but no log explains why the kept sessions were kept.
  Why it fails at runtime: An operator reviewing the session output sees `<m>=0` or no count at all and cannot distinguish "cleanup ran but matched nothing" from "cleanup did not run because the plan has no `Source issue:` line" from "cleanup ran but the label was still present". Diagnosing unarchived stopped sessions on resume becomes harder.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
